id: Professional Development and Vocational Programme Support
title: Professional Training and Capacity Development
label: Professional Training
line: Practical learning with a clear purpose.
intro: Customised learning for institutions, professionals and teams. Programmes begin with a needs assessment and clear learning objectives, and are delivered in Pashto, Dari or English through short courses, in-house programmes, mentoring, training of trainers or blended learning.
examples: Research methods, survey design and data analysis
Digital literacy and responsible use of AI
Support to appropriately authorised training providers
